main.description: Records a badge award to a user, project, or activity claim.

badge.description: Strong reference to the badge definition at the time of award. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.badge.definition.

subject.description: Entity the badge award is for (either an account DID or any specific AT Protocol record), e.g. a user, a project, or a specific activity claim.

note.description: Optional statement explaining the reason for this badge award.

url.description: Optional URL the badge award links to.

validFrom.description: When the badge starts to apply, which can differ from when this record was written (e.g. a certification granted in 2019 and recorded later). If omitted, the badge applies from createdAt. For date-only values, use midnight UTC (e.g. '2019-06-01T00:00:00.000Z'); consumers should treat only the date portion as canonical.

validUntil.description: When the badge stops applying, e.g. when a certification lapses or a verification needs renewal. Must not be earlier than validFrom. If omitted, the badge has no end date. After this time the award is expired: still a true historical statement ('was certified until …'), and clients should present it as such. Expiry is not revocation; to revoke an award, the issuer deletes the record. For date-only values, use midnight UTC; consumers should treat only the date portion as canonical.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.
